label: yciO
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the yciO window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yciO, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,420 to 2,499 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yciO once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 90% of genes, 0.53 bits on average (perplexity 1.7 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 31,980 calls, named 97%, 0.16 bits; shell 9,659 calls, named 76%, 1.21 bits; cloud 1,561 calls, named 16%, 3.85 bits. Outside an RGP 34,213 calls, named 96%, 0.20 bits; inside an RGP 8,987 calls, named 65%, 1.78 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 67 fork, 12 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.78 against 0.20 bits) and names fewer genes (65% against 96%); 8,987 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 26 ("hypothetical protein", a fork column) 1.26 bits, RGP 22%; column 11 (ompW, a fork column) 1.18 bits, RGP 14%; column 17 (kch, a fork column) 1.06 bits, RGP 25%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 1 spine column: named 99%, 0.18 bits on average; the 79 fork and variable columns: named 90%, 0.54 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 26, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: yciO "L-threonylcarbamoyladenylate syntha…". named 99%; 0.18 bits.
